::::{.columns}
:::{.column style="font-size:.6em; width:70%"}

1. sit somewhere (anywhere)
2. introduce yourselves to one another
3. fill in this (incredibly brief) attendance form &#8594;
4. open up the lab exercises (on Learn) and RStudio (either installed yourself, or use the server linked on Learn)
5. get started on working through the questions!
    - things are easier if you keep pace as a group. Stop between questions to make sure your table moves through together
    - anything you don't get to, finish up at home (solutions will be available on Fridays)
